hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -iqE "(implement|add feature|build feature|create instruction|add policy|new method|new page)"; then echo "[aegis402] TDD reminder: write the failing test first. See docs/CONVENTIONS.md §2 and the matching skill under .claude/skills/."; fi'

bash -c 'path="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$path" in *programs/aegis402/src/*) echo "[aegis402] Program source touched. Run: anchor test && cargo llvm-cov --fail-under-lines 100.";; *sdk/src/*) echo "[aegis402] SDK source touched. Run: pnpm --filter sdk test --coverage.";; esac'
